projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
An analytics dashboard project delivering three integrated data pipelines: (1) processing customer CSV files into structured datasets, (2) analyzing application logs for operational insights, and (3) visualization components that surface both data sources in an interactive dashboard UI. Structured into major milestones with tasks broken down so that no single task exceeds a complexity threshold of 7/10, ensuring each task is executable and manageable.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-processing, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: Milestone 1: Project Foundation & Architecture
tasks.details: Establish the technical foundation for the analytics dashboard: repository setup, technology choices, data model definitions, and the shared architecture that the CSV pipeline, log pipeline, and visualization layer will all build on. Acceptance: architecture decision record, working repo scaffold, and agreed data schemas for customer and log data.

tasks.name: Milestone 2: Customer CSV Data Processing Pipeline
tasks.details: Build the end-to-end ingestion and transformation pipeline for customer CSV files: file intake, validation, cleaning, normalisation, enrichment, and loading into the analytics store. Acceptance: representative customer CSV files flow through the pipeline into queryable structured datasets with documented quality checks.

tasks.name: Milestone 3: Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Build the ingestion and analysis pipeline for application logs: log collection, parsing into structured events, metrics/error aggregation, and storage in a query-ready form for dashboards. Acceptance: application log files parse into structured events with aggregated error rates, request volumes, and latency metrics available for querying.

tasks.name: Milestone 4: Visualization Components & Dashboard UI
tasks.details: Design and implement the dashboard's visualization layer: chart component library, dashboard layout, customer analytics views, operational log views, and interactivity (filters, drill-downs). Acceptance: a working dashboard that renders both customer data and log metrics with interactive filtering and responsive layout.

tasks.name: Milestone 5: Integration, Testing & Deployment
tasks.details: Integrate the three pipelines and UI into one deployable system: end-to-end tests, performance and load validation, security review, CI/CD, and production deployment with monitoring. Acceptance: a deployed dashboard running against real data with automated tests green and monitoring in place.

tasks.name: Define architecture and technology stack
tasks.details: Produce an architecture decision record covering: batch vs streaming ingestion, storage choice for analytics (e.g. warehouse/columnar store), processing framework, frontend framework and charting library, and how the CSV and log pipelines share a common serving layer. Include a component diagram and rationale. Acceptance: ADR reviewed and committed; every downstream task can name its tech dependency.

tasks.name: Set up repository, CI skeleton, and dev environment
tasks.details: Create the monorepo/repo scaffold (pipeline packages + frontend), linting/formatting, unit-test runner, pre-commit hooks, environment config/secrets handling, and a CI workflow that runs lint + tests on every push. Acceptance: a trivial test runs green in CI and a new developer can boot the environment from the README in under 30 minutes.

tasks.name: Define canonical data models and schemas
tasks.details: Specify and version-control the schemas both pipelines target: customer entity (customer_id, segment, geography, signup date, engagement metrics) and log event entity (timestamp, service, level, request_id, latency_ms, status_code, message). Include field types, nullability, PII classification, primary/foreign keys, and the aggregation tables the dashboard will read. Acceptance: schema files committed with validation tests, and both pipelines can validate against them.

tasks.name: Build CSV file intake and discovery layer
tasks.details: Implement upload/watch-folder/batch discovery for customer CSV files, including encoding detection (UTF-8/UTF-16/Latin-1), delimiter sniffing, header detection, file-level metadata tracking, and quarantine of unreadable files. Acceptance: intake handles a mixed sample set of CSVs and records source filename, checksum, row count, and receipt time per file.

tasks.name: Implement CSV schema validation and error routing
tasks.details: Validate each parsed CSV against the canonical customer schema: required columns, type coercion, date/number formats, allowed enum values, and referential checks. Route invalid rows to a reject table with a reason code per row; emit a validation summary (valid/invalid counts, top failure reasons). Acceptance: bad rows never reach the curated layer and every rejection is explainable.

tasks.name: Implement customer data cleaning and normalization
tasks.details: Trim and standardize strings, canonicalize country codes/currencies, unify date formats to UTC ISO-8601, coerce numerics with thousands separators, fill or flag missing values per documented policy, and normalize email/phone formats (hashing where PII policy requires). Acceptance: normalization rules are unit-tested and idempotent (running twice yields identical output).

tasks.name: Implement customer deduplication and enrichment
tasks.details: Deduplicate on customer_id with deterministic survivorship rules (latest non-null wins per field), detect fuzzy duplicate records and flag for review, and enrich with derived attributes (tenure bucket, activity score, lifecycle stage) computed from canonical fields. Acceptance: duplicate fixtures resolve to one golden record each and derived fields are documented and tested.

tasks.name: Load curated customer data into the analytics store
tasks.details: Write curated customer records to the analytics store using an idempotent upsert keyed on customer_id + source checksum, supporting backfills and re-runs without duplication. Include partitioning/clustering for query performance and a load audit log (rows inserted/updated/skipped). Acceptance: re-running the same file produces zero duplicate rows and the audit log reconciles counts.

tasks.name: Add CSV pipeline data-quality checks and tests
tasks.details: Implement automated quality gates: row-count reconciliation against source files, null-rate thresholds per critical column, duplicate-rate ceiling, and schema-drift detection. Add unit tests and integration tests using fixed CSV fixtures including malformed and edge-case files. Acceptance: quality report generated per run and pipeline fails loudly when thresholds are breached.

tasks.name: Build application log collection and ingestion
tasks.details: Implement ingestion for application log files/streams: file-tailing or batch pickup, rotation/gzip handling, multi-line stack-trace reassembly, backfill support, and per-source checkpoints so restarts resume without gaps or duplicates. Acceptance: ingestion survives log rotation and produces a raw event stream with source and offset metadata.

tasks.name: Implement log parsing into structured events
tasks.details: Convert raw log lines into the canonical log-event schema: timestamp parsing across formats/timezones, log-level mapping, request-id and trace-id extraction, status-code and latency extraction, and message templating. Include a parser fallback that preserves unparsed lines with a parse-error reason. Acceptance: parse-success rate measured on sample logs and above 95 percent.

tasks.name: Normalize logs, deduplicate, and redact PII
tasks.details: Standardize service names and environments, deduplicate events on request_id plus timestamp plus checksum, and apply regex-based redaction for emails, tokens, IPs, and card-like patterns before persistence. Acceptance: redaction test suite passes with no raw PII in stored events and dedupe removes exact retries.

tasks.name: Build log metrics aggregation layer
tasks.details: Compute time-windowed aggregates for the dashboard: error rate by service and level, request volume per interval, p50/p95/p99 latency, top error signatures, and slowest endpoints. Support a configurable window granularity of minute, hour, and day. Acceptance: aggregates reconcile against raw-event counts for a known sample period.

tasks.name: Load log events and metrics into the query layer
tasks.details: Persist structured log events and aggregate tables into the analytics store with time-based partitioning, retention policy, and query indexes tuned for dashboard filters. Provide a small query API or view layer that the frontend can call with time range, service, and level filters. Acceptance: dashboard-style queries return in under two seconds on representative data volume.

tasks.name: Create log pipeline test fixtures and automated tests
tasks.details: Build a fixture corpus of realistic log samples (JSON, plaintext, multi-line stack traces, malformed lines, multiple timezones) and automated tests covering parsing, redaction, aggregation correctness, and checkpoint resume behavior. Acceptance: test suite runs in CI and covers each pipeline stage.

tasks.name: Design dashboard UX, information architecture, and wireframes
tasks.details: Define the dashboard's user journeys and layout: executive overview, customer analytics section, and operational health section. Produce low-fidelity wireframes, a chart-type selection rationale per metric, and a component inventory. Acceptance: wireframes reviewed and signed off before component implementation begins.

tasks.name: Build reusable chart component library
tasks.details: Implement a small set of parameterized chart components (time series, bar, stacked area, KPI tile, data table with sorting) with loading, empty, and error states, consistent theming, and tooltip formatting. Acceptance: each component has a Storybook-style demo and unit tests for data-to-render mapping.

tasks.name: Build dashboard shell, routing, and data-fetching layer
tasks.details: Create the app shell with navigation, route structure for overview/customer/operations pages, a typed API client, request caching and retry, and global loading/error handling. Acceptance: navigating between placeholder pages fetches from the query API with cache hits visible on repeat navigation.

tasks.name: Implement customer analytics dashboard views
tasks.details: Assemble the customer analytics page from the chart library: customer growth over time, segment and geography breakdowns, engagement distribution, and a sortable customer table backed by curated data. Acceptance: views render real curated data and match the approved wireframes.

tasks.name: Implement operational log and health views
tasks.details: Assemble the operations page: error-rate trend, request volume, latency percentiles, top error signatures, and a filterable log explorer with pagination. Acceptance: every widget is driven by the metrics API and matches the approved wireframes.

tasks.name: Add filters, drill-downs, and cross-chart interactivity
tasks.details: Implement global time-range and segment filters, URL-persisted filter state, click-to-drill-down from aggregate charts into underlying records, and coordinated highlighting across related widgets. Acceptance: filter changes refetch efficiently and state is shareable via URL.

tasks.name: Responsive layout and accessibility pass
tasks.details: Make the dashboard usable from wide desktop down to tablet/mobile breakpoints; add keyboard navigation, focus states, ARIA labelling for charts, sufficient colour contrast, and non-colour-only encoding of series. Acceptance: automated accessibility scan has no critical violations and layout holds at each breakpoint.

tasks.name: Build end-to-end integration test suite
tasks.details: Create an end-to-end test that ingests a sample CSV batch and a sample log batch, runs both pipelines, and asserts the dashboard API returns expected aggregates. Include contract tests between frontend and API and automated regression snapshots. Acceptance: suite runs green in CI from a clean environment in under 15 minutes.

tasks.name: Run performance and load testing
tasks.details: Benchmark pipeline throughput on realistic CSV and log volumes, measure dashboard API latency under concurrent load, and identify the slowest queries. Produce a report with bottlenecks and tuning actions; set performance budgets. Acceptance: dashboard p95 API latency meets the agreed budget and pipeline completes within the batch window.

tasks.name: Security and data-privacy review
tasks.details: Review PII handling across customer CSVs and logs, verify encryption in transit and at rest, check access control and secrets management, confirm log redaction, add dependency vulnerability scanning, and document data retention. Acceptance: no critical or high findings unresolved before launch.

tasks.name: Set up CI/CD pipeline and infrastructure as code
tasks.details: Define infrastructure as code for the analytics store, pipeline runners, and frontend hosting; build the deployment pipeline with environment promotion (dev to staging to prod), automated migrations, and rollback. Acceptance: a one-command deploy to staging succeeds from a clean commit and rollback is verified.

tasks.name: Production deployment with monitoring and alerting
tasks.details: Deploy to production, configure pipeline run monitoring, data-freshness alerts, API error-rate and latency alerts, and dashboard uptime checks. Include a supervised first production run against real customer CSVs and logs. Acceptance: alerts fire correctly in a test scenario and the first production data load reconciles.

tasks.name: Write documentation and operational runbook
tasks.details: Document architecture, data schemas and field definitions, pipeline operation (how to add a CSV, reprocess a batch, replay logs), dashboard metric definitions, and incident runbook including common failure modes and recovery steps. Acceptance: a new team member can operate and troubleshoot the system from the docs alone.
